title: AEF 1.0: one line of results.ndjson
description: One node of a run's result tree. A composite node carries aggregation; its children carry component and parentResultId.

schemaVersion.description: The AEF version this line follows, MAJOR.MINOR: 1.0 for AEF 1.0 (VER-1).

resultId.description: The line's id, a hash of runId, caseId, path and trial, so the same run read twice gives the same ids. Unique in the run (RES-4).

parentResultId.description: The resultId of the composite node this line is a child of; absent or null on a root. It must be a line of the run (RES-5).

caseId.description: The case this line belongs to: 1-256 characters, with no control character (RES-4).

path.description: The node's place in the tree, / between levels.

trial.description: 0-based trial, when the case ran several times. Written as plain integer digits (no fraction, no exponent).

trials.description: The rollup line of a case that ran several times. The case's result is this line, never one trial; agree false marks it flaky.

n.description: How many trials the case had, from 1 to 1000 (RES-8).

passed.description: How many of the n trials passed; never more than n (RES-8).

aggregation.description: How the trials were combined into the case's state: MajorityVote, AllPass, AnyPass, Mean, Median, Max or PassAtK (with k). Descriptive: a reader shows it, never recomputes it (RES-8).

agree.description: Whether the trials agreed. false marks the case as flaky (RES-8).

k.description: k, for PassAtK: the case passes when at least one of k trials passes.

evaluator.description: The evaluator that produced this line.

id.description: The evaluator's id, as the producer names it.

state.description: The node's state. passed is the only pass; failed and warn (a soft failure) are measured failures; inconclusive is measured, undecided; not_measured, not_applicable, skipped, error and pending are typed absences (RES-1).

reason.description: Why the line is in a typed absence: required for not_measured, not_applicable, skipped, error and pending (RES-2). Optional otherwise.

scores.description: The node's scores, one per metric. A line in a typed absence carries none (RES-2, RES-10).

metric.description: The metric, by its id in metrics.json (SUM-1).

value.description: The score, on the metric's scale (RES-10).

normalized.description: The score normalised to between 0 and 1, or null when the producer gives none (RES-10).

label.description: A categorical value for the metric (an OpenTelemetry score label, Inspect's C/I/P/N, a grader's class), shown as written (RES-10).

verdictRule.description: The rule that turned the scores into the state, and where its threshold came from.

expr.description: A human-readable description of the rule; a reader never evaluates it (spec 03, RES-7).

threshold.description: The threshold the rule compared the score with, or null when it has none.

source.description: Where the threshold came from, as the producer names it.

annotator.description: Who or what decided this node.

kind.description: Who graded: CODE (code), LLM (a language model), HUMAN (a person) or HYBRID (a combination). A reader shows a kind it does not know as written (RES-10, VER-3).

model.description: The model that graded, when one did.

promptHash.description: The SHA-256 of the prompt the grader was given (RES-10).

rubricDigest.description: The SHA-256 of the rubric the grader used (RES-10).

panel.description: For a panel of graders: how many agreed, of how many (RES-10).

agree.description: How many panel members agreed; never more than of (RES-10).

of.description: How many members the panel had (RES-10).

reasoning.description: The judge's reasoning, stored as a content-addressed blob (blobs/sha256/ab/<hex>) when content capture allows.

blob.description: The digest of the blob holding the reasoning; its hex is the blob's file name (EVD-3).

bytes.description: The blob's size in bytes. A size that is not the blob's is reported as reasoning-size.

uncertainty.description: How uncertain the node's score is: a standard error, an interval, or both; null when not given (RES-10).

stderr.description: The standard error of the score.

usage.description: What producing this node consumed, one entry per party (the agent, a judge, an attacker): no role and model twice (RES-10).

items.description: What one party consumed producing this node: tokens in OpenTelemetry's gen_ai.usage.* names, and cost (RES-10).

role.description: Whose usage this is: agent (the subject), judge, attacker (an attacker model) or other.

model.description: The model this party used, when it used one: with role, it tells two judges of a panel apart (RES-10).

costSource.description: Where the cost figure came from, such as a price table.

gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens.description: Input tokens served from a cache, as OpenTelemetry's gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens; included in input_tokens (RES-10).

gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens.description: Input tokens written to a cache, as OpenTelemetry's gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens; included in input_tokens (RES-10).

gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens.description: Reasoning tokens, as OpenTelemetry's gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens; included in output_tokens (RES-10).

traceLink.description: The span this result was produced in, or with traceId only, the trace (RES-10). It resolves against traces.otlp.jsonl when that file is present (spec 03, §3.9 trace-link).

traceId.description: The trace id: 32 lower-case hex characters.

spanId.description: The span id: 16 lower-case hex characters.

aggregation.description: On a composite node: how its children became its verdict, and which branch of the verdict rules decided it.

strategy.description: The strategy the producer used, for display: aggregation is descriptive (spec 03, RES-6).

threshold.description: The threshold the composite score was compared with, or null (RES-5).

score.description: The composite score the strategy gave, or null when it gave none (RES-5).

rulePath.description: Which branch of the producer's verdict rules decided the state, for display (spec 03, RES-6).

measured.description: How many children were measured; at most total (RES-6).

total.description: How many children the node has (RES-5).

minimumMeasuredShare.description: The share of children, from 0 to 1, the producer's rules require to be measured. Fewer gives the rule path under-covered.

unmeasured.description: The children not measured, by state.

pending.description: Children not finished (only in an open run). Absent means 0 (RES-6).

decisive.description: The children that decided the verdict, as the producer knew them. A reader never reverse-engineers this.

component.description: On a child of a composite: its weight and whether it is required.

weight.description: The child's weight in its parent's strategy, 0 or more (RES-5).

required.description: Whether the parent's rules require this child (RES-5).

evidence.description: Ids of records in evidence.ndjson this node cites.

ext.description: Producer extensions, named reverse-DNS or with the producer's prefix. A reader ignores what it does not know; never holds a secret (ENC-19).

lane.description: The summary lane this line belongs to; may be absent when the summary has one lane (spec 03, SUM-3).

severity.description: How bad a failure is. A failed or warn line should carry it; where a rule needs a missing one, it counts as critical (RES-9).

durationMs.description: Wall-clock time the result took, in milliseconds.

attack.description: For an adversarial case: the technique, its ids in public taxonomies, and whether it succeeded (null when not decided).

technique.description: The attack technique, as the producer names it (RES-10).

taxonomy.description: The technique's ids in public taxonomies, none listed twice (RES-10).

scheme.description: owasp-llm, owasp-agentic, mitre-atlas, nist-ai-rmf or other.

id.description: The technique's id in that taxonomy, such as LLM01.

success.description: Whether the attack succeeded; null when that was not decided (RES-10).

startedAt.description: When work on this node started (RES-10).

endedAt.description: When work on this node ended; not before startedAt (RES-10, result-times in §3.9).

state.description: Applies to a line in a typed absence (RES-2).

allOf.description: A typed absence says why, and carries no scores (spec 03, RES-2).

interval.description: An interval at a confidence level, and how it was computed.

level.description: The confidence level, strictly between 0 and 1: 0.95 for a 95% interval.

method.description: How the interval was computed, as the producer names it.
